_about: shove1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/shove1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

sv.shove.hit._orig: the shock wave arriving: the weight thrown back onto the rear leg, the chest and head pushed back, the fists coming up out of the guard; three ticks, a recoil and not a stance

sv.shove.dig._orig: digging in: the knees deep on a wide stance, the body leaning into the blast with the head tucked behind the forearms, both fists up in front of the face with the elbows low; the feet slide and the body does not give

sv.shove.settle._orig: the slide ending: the body coming up out of the dig into the aggressive stand, the guard still in front
